sobre.title: About Me
sobre.description: I'm a Computer Science student offering technical support, development, and cybersecurity services with a focus on quality and trust.

historia.title: 📚 My Journey
historia.text: I'm currently in my 3rd term of a Systems Analysis and Development degree, where I've been building a solid foundation in software development. Throughout the course, I've worked with Java, Spring Boot, SQL, and Python on hands-on projects, and I'm self-taught in cybersecurity — studying independently through ethical hacking platforms and specialized content. DEV Soluções em TI was born from the desire to combine that technical knowledge with close, honest service — whether it's everyday support or a more complex development project.

missao.title: 🎯 My Mission
missao.text: To provide IT services with quality, ethics, and transparency, always prioritizing the security and satisfaction of those who trust my work — whether it's simple support or a more complex project.
